lines.00_same: We focus on practical application, not technology for its own sake. We test what works, understand the risks, and help WFP prepare for the future.
lines.01_hook: Doing the same task over and over again? Let's automate it.
lines.02_pain: Chasing leads, sorting emails, updating your CRM, building reports by hand... it eats your week.
lines.03_who: I'm Usman. I build n8n automations and AI-powered workflows that connect your apps, capture leads from every source, follow up with customers, and keep your data in sync, automatically.
lines.04_more: Need an AI chatbot, an AI agent, or a custom API integration? I'll build it around how your business actually works.
lines.05_value: The goal isn't just automation. It's saving you hours, cutting errors, and giving you time to grow.
lines.06_cta: Send me your idea, and let's turn it into a workflow that runs itself.
